messages:
Monica Chen: Quick handoff — I'm moving the Llama3-smallq onboarding to QA today. PR is ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/482. Can someone take a lightweight smoke pass on the Spanish prompt set and reranker signals?

Ava Patel: I'll do the Spanish promptset smoke this morning, aiming for <30m. Any specific prompts to focus on?

Monica Chen: Focus on the named-entity redaction and address-normalization prompts (last 3 in the suite). Also check function-calling structured outputs — especially the `extract_address` schema.

Raj Singh: Pinged for code review + reranker flaky test investigation. I'll try to repro the intermittent low-precision case; saw one failing CI run earlier. @CI-Bot can you re-run the failing job ?

CI-Bot: Re-run queued for models/pr/482 · job: tests/e2e-rerank (priority: low) — will post results here.

Leo Martín: Heads-up on infra: KV cache warmup needs to be enabled for this model variant (sequence prefix averaging). Suggested config snippet: 
```
serving.kv_cache: 
  warmup: true
  prefix_tokens: 4
  concurrency: 8
```
This reduces first-request latency spike.

Emma Brooks: Small note: Our canary route currently sends 5% shadow traffic to dedicated nodes. If smoke shows any quality regression, we should hold rollout and flip to shadow-only.

Monica Chen: Good call. Add an explicit rollback trigger: latency > 250ms OR reranker precision drop > 3pt. Also add a promptset smoke checklist to the PR description.

Ava Patel: Running smoke now. Command I'm using: `pytest tests/smoke/test_promptset.py::test_spanish -k "llama3" -q` — will drop results in the PR.

Raj Singh: Found one flaky assertion in reranker test: `assert top_k_precision >= 0.72` — flaps when batch size=1. Reproduced locally with `python -m pytest tests/e2e/test_rerank.py::test_precision -k batch1`. Leaving a tiny patch in the PR for defensive tolerance + comment.

Monica Chen: Thanks — please avoid broadening tolerance; prefer deterministic fix if feasible. If it's infra-related (batching/kv), note it in the PR and we can patch the test short-term.

Raj Singh: Understood — I'll try a fix that stabilizes logits ordering by seeding the scorer and adding a small temperature clamp. If I can't, I'll document and add a TODO.

CI-Bot: e2e-rerank job finished — all green on re-run.

Ava Patel: Smoke done. Spanish promptset: 28/30 checks passed. Two minor formatting mismatches in `postcode` extraction — dropping to PR comments. No obvious quality regressions in generated text. :thumbsup:

Monica Chen: Amazing — thanks everyone. Next steps: @Raj land the deterministic reranker fix, @Ava and @Emma confirm canary traffic still looks clean after Raj's change. I'll update the PR description with the smoke checklist and rollback criteria.

DeployBot: Canary deployment started for models/llama3-smallq@v1.2.0 — 5% shadow, 0% live. Will report metrics to the console in ~10m.

Monica Chen: If anyone finds anything weird in the next 30m, drop it here. Otherwise I'll mark the onboarding as QA-passed and move to staged rollout.

Leo Martín: Noted — I'll monitor KV hit-rate and first-byte latency in console and post any anomalies.

Emma Brooks: I'll keep an eye on regressions dashboard and ping if any signal crosses threshold.

Monica Chen: Thanks all — that should be it for the handoff. :party_popper:
